tldr: 台股大漲1,783點（+4.2%）創收盤最大漲點，台積電、聯發科領軍，一掃上週急跌陰霾。
記憶體續為最熱題材，大摩重申基本面未惡化、估Q3 DRAM價漲逾25%，7月漲幅一度達45%。
美股受財報捷報帶動終止連三黑，那斯達克領漲，市場靜候本週Alphabet、Tesla、IBM財報。
台灣6月CPI升至2.6%創17個月新高，惟央行總裁估下半年降溫，Fed 7月料按兵不動。
財管2.0持續擴容，金管會核准土地銀行與華南永昌證辦理高資產業務，全體管理資產今年拚3兆元。

items.title_zh: 台股勁揚1,783點至44,233 創最大漲點 電子權值領軍反攻
items.title_en: TAIEX rockets 1,783 points to 44,233 in record point gain as heavyweight tech leads rebound
items.summary_zh: 台股在台積電、聯發科等電子權值股領軍下強勢反彈，終場大漲1,783.17點（+4.20%）收44,232.87點，創收盤最大漲點紀錄。台積電漲逾4%重回領頭羊，聯發科亮燈漲停、收3,670元漲330元；面板、PCB與被動元件同步走強，顯示資金重回AI供應鏈逢低承接，一掃上週急跌陰霾。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's benchmark index staged its largest-ever point gain, surging 1,783.17 points (+4.20%) to close at 44,232.87 as electronic heavyweights led a broad recovery from last week's rout. TSMC climbed more than 4% to reclaim market leadership, while MediaTek locked limit-up, ending NT$330 higher at NT$3,670. Panel, PCB and passive-component names joined the advance, signalling bargain-hunting returned across the AI supply chain.

items.title_zh: 內資撐盤 投信買超172億 外資連13賣
items.title_en: Domestic funds anchor the rally as trust houses buy while foreigners sell for a 13th day
items.summary_zh: 三大法人合計買超台股164.07億元，但本波反彈主由內資撐盤而非外資。投信積極卡位買超172.32億元，外資則賣超43.32億元、連13個交易日站賣方。內外資動向分歧，凸顯目前撐起大盤的是本土資金動能，而非海外回流；後續反彈能否延續，仍須觀察外資是否回頭轉買與量能是否持續放大。
items.summary_en: The three major institutional groups bought a net NT$16.4 billion of Taiwan shares, but the rebound was powered by domestic money rather than foreigners. Securities investment trusts bought a net NT$17.23 billion, while foreign investors sold a net NT$4.33 billion, extending their selling streak to 13 sessions. The divergence underscores how local liquidity, not overseas inflows, is currently underpinning the market's recovery.

items.title_zh: 力積電法說報喜 7月記憶體漲價45% 法人調升目標價
items.title_en: Powerchip earnings call flags 45% July memory price surge; analysts lift targets
items.summary_zh: 力積電法說會釋出樂觀訊號，7月記憶體合約價漲幅一度上看45%，為結構性多頭循環的最新一波。管理層指出DRAM供給吃緊、AI需求強勁，帶動法人全面調升記憶體族群目標價與評等。因生產週期遞延，營收與獲利完全反映預估落在11至12月，成熟製程記憶體廠續為市場焦點，惟仍須留意漲價動能能否延續與後續擴產變數。
items.summary_en: Powerchip (PSMC) delivered a bullish earnings call as memory contract prices jumped as much as 45% in July, the latest leg of a structural up-cycle. Management pointed to tight DRAM supply and AI-driven demand, prompting institutions to raise target prices and ratings across the memory chain. Because of production lead times, the full revenue and profit benefit is expected to surface in November-December, keeping mature-node memory makers in sharp focus.

items.title_zh: 大摩：記憶體基本面未惡化 估Q3 DRAM價漲逾25%
items.title_en: Morgan Stanley says memory fundamentals intact, sees Q3 DRAM prices up over 25%
items.summary_zh: 記憶體股近期遭獲利回吐賣壓，摩根士丹利澄清產業基本面完全沒有惡化，預期第3季DRAM合約價季增逾25%。此番喊話帶動南亞科等記憶體股領軍週二反彈。分析師將本波回檔定調為超級循環中的技術洗盤，主要原廠將產能轉向高毛利HBM與DDR5，使標準型DRAM供給持續吃緊，支撐後市價格動能，惟仍須觀察擴產進度與終端需求變化。
items.summary_en: After a bout of profit-taking hit memory shares, Morgan Stanley clarified that industry fundamentals have not deteriorated, forecasting third-quarter DRAM contract prices will rise more than 25% quarter-on-quarter. The reassurance helped memory names such as Nanya lead Tuesday's rebound. Analysts frame the pullback as a technical shakeout within an ongoing super-cycle, as top makers steer capacity toward high-margin HBM and DDR5 and keep legacy DRAM supply tight.

items.title_zh: 金管會修正利變型保單規範 強化揭露保障保戶
items.title_en: FSC tightens disclosure rules for interest-sensitive life policies to protect policyholders
items.summary_zh: 金管會修正「人身保險業辦理利率變動型保險商品業務應注意事項」，強化利率變動型保險商品的資訊揭露機制，並加強保障保戶權益。此次修正旨在確保消費者充分理解這類熱銷儲蓄型保單的運作與潛在風險，反映主管機關在高利率環境下，持續提升壽險業銷售行為標準、督促業者落實公平待客與資訊透明的政策方向。
items.summary_en: The Financial Supervisory Commission amended its guidelines governing interest-sensitive (rate-variable) life insurance products, strengthening information-disclosure requirements and reinforcing protection of policyholder rights. The revision aims to ensure consumers better understand the mechanics and risks of these popular savings-linked policies. It reflects the regulator's continued push to raise sales-conduct standards across the life-insurance sector amid a high-rate environment.

items.title_zh: 金管會許可歐付寶經營國外小額匯兌 便利移工
items.title_en: FSC clears O'Pay to run small-value cross-border remittances for migrant workers
items.summary_zh: 金管會許可歐付寶電子支付經營國外小額匯兌業務，並兼營外籍移工國外小額匯兌。此執照擴大了傳統銀行與非正式管道之外、受監理且成本較低的匯款選擇，為台灣建構金融科技與電子支付生態系的又一進展，可改善為數眾多外籍移工的金融近用，讓其定期匯款返鄉更便利、透明且安全，並有助強化跨境資金流動的合規監理。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved electronic-payment operator O'Pay to conduct small-value foreign remittance services, including a dedicated channel for foreign migrant workers. The licence expands regulated, lower-cost remittance options beyond traditional banks and informal channels. It marks another step in Taiwan's build-out of the fintech and e-payment ecosystem, improving financial access for a large migrant-worker population that regularly sends money home.

items.title_zh: 土地銀行獲准辦理高資產客戶財管2.0業務
items.title_en: Land Bank wins FSC nod to offer high-asset (Wealth 2.0) products and services
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意臺灣土地銀行辦理高資產客戶適用之金融商品及服務，正式取得財管2.0資格。此核准為競逐台灣快速成長高資產客群的銀行陣容再添一家公股大行；近年高資產客戶數與管理資產規模年增顯著。此舉將擴大提供高資產投資人的海外債、結構型商品與客製化資產配置方案選擇，深化私人銀行與財富傳承服務量能。
items.summary_en: The FSC approved state-owned Land Bank to provide financial products and services to high-net-worth clients under the "Wealth Management 2.0" regime. The green light adds another major lender to the roster competing for Taiwan's fast-growing affluent segment, where high-asset client counts and AUM have expanded sharply year-on-year. It broadens the range of overseas bonds, structured products and bespoke allocation solutions available to wealthy investors.

items.title_zh: 華南永昌證獲准開辦財管2.0 券商跨入私銀里程碑
items.title_en: Hua Nan Securities cleared for Wealth 2.0, a private-banking milestone for brokers
items.summary_zh: 華南永昌證券獲准開辦高資產財管2.0業務，象徵券商深入過往由銀行主導的私人銀行領域的重要里程碑。此舉使券商能為高資產客戶提供更完整的商品線與跨境解決方案，反映市場競逐台灣高資產投資人日益白熱化。全體財管2.0管理資產今年可望挑戰3兆元大關，通路多元化將推升整體財富管理市場的競爭強度與服務升級。
items.summary_en: Hua Nan Yong Chang Securities received regulatory approval to launch high-asset Wealth Management 2.0 services, a milestone as securities firms push deeper into private banking traditionally dominated by banks. The move lets brokers offer high-net-worth clients a wider suite of products and cross-border solutions. It signals intensifying competition for Taiwan's affluent investors, whose managed assets are projected to challenge NT$3 trillion this year.

items.title_zh: 財政部核釋 繼承受贈舊制房屋交易所得納物價調整
items.title_en: MOF sets inflation-indexed cost basis for inherited or gifted old-regime houses
items.summary_zh: 財政部7月16日發布核釋，明確個人交易繼承或受贈取得之舊制房屋的所得計算方式，納入按物價指數調整的機制。此舉允許納稅人依物價變動調整取得成本，減輕此類房產處分的稅負，並提升舊制（非房地合一）房屋交易稅制的公平性，讓長期持有後移轉的稅負計算更趨合理，對繼承取得老屋的家庭具實質減負效果。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's Ministry of Finance issued an interpretive ruling on July 16 clarifying how to calculate income from selling old-regime houses acquired through inheritance or gift, incorporating an inflation-index adjustment mechanism. The move lets taxpayers adjust the acquisition cost for price changes, easing the tax burden on such property disposals and improving fairness in the older, non-consolidated housing-transaction tax framework for long-held assets.

items.title_zh: 2026報稅減稅 免稅額、扣除額調高 遺贈稅不變
items.title_en: 2026 income-tax filing brings tax cuts via higher allowances and deductions
items.summary_zh: 財政部2026年報稅季調高免稅額與標準扣除額，並提高長照與幼兒特別扣除額，將租金支出改列特別扣除額，同時上調課稅級距金額，以增加家庭可支配所得。惟遺產稅與贈與稅免稅額維持不變，因2025年CPI變動未達10%的調整門檻，多數民眾綜所稅負可望減輕，其中租屋族受惠尤為明顯。
items.summary_en: For the 2026 filing season, the Ministry of Finance raised the basic personal exemption and standard deductions, lifted the long-term-care and preschool special deductions, reclassified rental expenses as a special deduction, and nudged tax brackets upward, aiming to boost households' disposable income. The estate- and gift-tax exemptions, however, stay unchanged as 2025 CPI moves did not reach the 10% adjustment threshold.

items.title_zh: 台灣6月CPI年增2.6% 創17個月新高 破通膨警戒線
items.title_en: Taiwan's June CPI hits 2.6%, a 17-month high, above the 2% alert line
items.summary_zh: 台灣6月消費者物價指數（CPI）年增2.60%，創近17個月新高，並連續兩個月突破2%通膨警戒線，主因油價與菜價上漲。主計總處預估，隨國際油價回落與端午節效應結束，7月漲幅可望略低於6月，但通膨黏著仍使政策關注度居高，市場密切留意輸入型物價壓力後續走向與是否牽動貨幣政策。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's consumer price index rose 2.60% year-on-year in June, the highest in about 17 months and a second straight month above the 2% inflation-alert threshold, driven by higher oil and vegetable prices. The statistics agency expects July's reading to ease slightly as international oil prices retreat and Dragon Boat Festival effects fade, but sticky inflation keeps policy attention high.

items.title_zh: 央行總裁楊金龍：下半年通膨可望降溫 全年CPI守2%以下
items.title_en: Central bank chief sees inflation cooling in H2 as import-price pressure eases
items.summary_zh: 央行總裁楊金龍表示，6月CPI與央行原先預估差不多，主要受短期因素影響。隨國際油價下降，輸入型通膨壓力已消除，預期今年下半年通膨將逐步降溫，全年CPI年增率仍可控制在2%以下。此番談話釋出央行短期內傾向按兵不動、維持利率不變的政策訊號，市場預期第3季政策利率不變的機率偏高。
items.summary_en: Central bank governor Yang Chin-long said June CPI was broadly in line with the bank's forecast and driven by short-term factors. With international oil prices falling, he judged that imported-inflation pressure has dissipated and expects inflation to cool gradually in the second half, keeping full-year CPI growth below 2%. The comments signal the central bank is comfortable holding policy steady for now.

items.title_zh: 外電：Fed 7月料按兵不動 降息預期持續消退
items.title_en: Fed widely expected to hold in July as rate-cut bets fade
items.summary_zh: 據台灣財經媒體引述調查，多數經濟學家預期聯準會（Fed）今年剩餘時間將維持利率不變，而非啟動降息，7月維持利率不變為市場約七成共識。受通膨黏著、關稅重組與油價高企影響，降息預期持續往後遞延，使政策路徑更趨依賴數據，市場對年內是否降息分歧加大，須留意後續通膨與就業數據。
items.summary_en: Most economists expect the Federal Reserve to keep rates unchanged through the rest of 2026 rather than begin cutting, with a July hold seen as a roughly 70% market consensus, according to Taiwanese financial media citing surveys. Persistent inflation, tariff realignment and high oil prices have pushed rate-cut expectations further out, leaving the policy path highly data-dependent and dividing views on whether any cut lands this year.

items.title_zh: 外電：Fed示警中東油價衝擊 成金融體系頭號風險
items.title_en: Fed flags Middle East-driven oil-price shock as top financial risk
items.summary_zh: 台灣媒體報導，聯準會警告中東衝突持續引發的油價衝擊，已躍升為金融體系的最大風險。今年以來能源價格大幅反彈，重新引發市場對供給面壓力恐使核心通膨居高不下的疑慮，也使央行寬鬆政策空間受限，為全球市場增添地緣政治不確定性，投資人須留意油價與中東情勢後續發展。
items.summary_en: Taiwanese media reported the Federal Reserve has warned that an oil-price shock stemming from persistent Middle East conflict has become the leading risk to the financial system. Energy prices have rebounded sharply this year, reviving concern that supply-side pressures could keep core inflation elevated and complicate the central bank's ability to ease policy, adding a geopolitical overhang to global markets.

items.title_zh: 美股終止連三黑 財報捷報帶動反彈（2026-07-21）
items.title_en: US stocks break three-day losing streak as earnings lift the market
items.summary_zh: 美股週二止跌反彈，終結連三個交易日下跌，財報季開局強勁。道瓊漲385點（+0.74%）收52,224.64點，標普500漲0.89%收7,509.20點，那斯達克漲1.29%收25,837.21點。目前已公布財報的標普成分股近88%獲利優於預期，惟中東緊張情勢仍為市場隱憂。
items.summary_en: Wall Street's major indexes snapped a three-day skid on Tuesday, powered by a strong start to earnings season. The Dow rose 385 points (+0.74%) to 52,224.64, the S&P 500 gained 0.89% to 7,509.20 and the Nasdaq added 1.29% to 25,837.21. Nearly 88% of the S&P 500 firms reporting so far have topped profit estimates, though Middle East tensions lingered.

items.title_zh: 3M財報優於預期大漲逾7% 通用汽車利多不漲（2026-07-21）
items.title_en: 3M rallies over 7% on earnings beat while GM slips despite upbeat results
items.summary_zh: 工業指標股3M第2季財報優於預期，股價大漲逾7%，帶動道瓊走高。通用汽車營收與獲利同步優於預期，股價卻小跌，投資人聚焦關稅與利潤率壓力。晶片股同步反彈，市場整體風險偏好回升，帶動大盤走勢轉強。
items.summary_en: Industrial bellwether 3M jumped more than 7% after second-quarter results topped expectations, helping lift the Dow. General Motors also beat on the top and bottom lines, but its shares slipped as investors focused on tariff and margin pressures. Chip stocks rebounded alongside, adding to the risk-on tone across the broader market.

items.title_zh: 丹納赫下修財測 股價暴跌近14%（2026-07-21）
items.title_en: Danaher plunges nearly 14% after cutting its revenue outlook
items.summary_zh: 生命科學與診斷大廠丹納赫（Danaher）股價重挫約13.7%，為當日標普500表現最差個股之一，主因公司下修第3季營收財測、低於市場預期。管理層指出生物製程需求疲弱、全年展望保守。此利空拖累醫療保健類股，即使大盤在其他強勁財報帶動下走高。
items.summary_en: Life-sciences and diagnostics group Danaher tumbled about 13.7%, one of the day's worst S&P 500 performers, after issuing weaker-than-expected third-quarter revenue guidance. Management cited soft bioprocessing demand and a cautious full-year outlook. The slide weighed on the health-care sector even as the broader market advanced on upbeat earnings elsewhere.

items.title_zh: MSCI財報遜色 股價重挫約11%（2026-07-21）
items.title_en: MSCI slides about 11% after a quarterly earnings miss
items.summary_zh: 指數與分析服務供應商MSCI第2季財報遜於華爾街預期，股價下跌約10.7%，成為另一檔因財報下挫的重量級個股。此跌勢凸顯本季投資人對財報不如預期的懲罰力道明顯，即使多數已公布公司優於預期，個股波動仍高，市場靜候科技巨頭財報揭曉。
items.summary_en: Index and analytics provider MSCI fell roughly 10.7% after its second-quarter results missed Wall Street estimates, making it another notable earnings-driven decliner. The drop underscored how sharply investors are punishing misses this season even as most reporting companies beat forecasts, keeping single-stock volatility elevated ahead of Big Tech results.
